description: Gifts PostThisDeal’s editors picked for the Gift Room (https://postthisdeal.com/gift-ideas/), each with who it suits (gift.for, gift.labels) and the editor’s line on why it makes a good gift (gift.note). Filter by who it’s for and a price limit (only prices we can show count; Amazon prices only from Amazon’s API within 24 hours). Each deal starts with summary_one_line (quote it as written). Cite canonical_url, buy via go_url (unchanged), and always give price.as_of and check.state (verified_fresh, as_posted, stale, price_changed, out_of_stock, unpriced, expired: see methodology_url). Savings appear only against a verified reference. These are the same evidence Covetta, PostThisDeal’s deal assistant, uses.
name: get_gift_ideas
title: PostThisDeal Gift Room: gift ideas
